pull_request.title: Documentation: Outline TDR structure and publication plan
pull_request.head: documentation/tdr-publication-plan
pull_request.body:
PubDoc has drafted the whole-detector TDR frame so chapters can grow alongside designs and validation. The proposal expands the development plan into 13 chapters with numbered sections/subsections, six appendices and a 15-row chapter/claim evidence map.

Read [the outline](docs/publication/TDR-outline.md) for the report structure and [the publication plan](docs/publication/publication-plan.md) for responsibilities, priorities, missing inputs and review gates. The proposed writing order is:

1. Scope, lineage, provenance, requirements and reproduction conventions.
2. Architecture and the existing pixel dossier, with exact input revisions and visible material/interface gaps.
3. Strip, timing, calorimeter, muon and common-services inputs, plus staged simulation methods.
4. Demonstrated performance, controlled ODD comparisons and a reproducible report/release candidate.

Please review the chapter coverage, first writing increments and input/reviewer ownership. Beamspot and performance criteria, complete component/services budgets, physical field maps, production simulation and integrated performance remain missing inputs. The tracker-layout study remains paused. Final naming, authorship and venue can follow the technical drafting.

`Documentation: <description>` is now recorded and checked as a PR category. It requires project tracking; publication work and the TDR pointer cannot use the infrastructure exemption. TASK-B-PUB records delivery of this draft frame, and PR #16 merge metadata is reconciled.

The outline is reviewed in the parent repository. The Overleaf-backed TDR submodule is unchanged; the plan describes its later LaTeX migration and manual publication workflow. No new scientific parameters, source-catalogue entries, design approvals or publication authorization are introduced. Final sign-off authority remains `asalzburger-review`.

Validation: PR naming/tracking tests, dashboard and session checks, local documentation links and static dashboard build. Detailed actual results are retained in `logs/codex/SESSION-2026-09-22-tdr-publication-plan.json`. No detector validation or LaTeX build is claimed.
